title: Four target-side facts of the case list and its export are not fixed by any source, and the sources disagree on the team filter
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-031 sections 3, 4, 12 and 13; Technical Specifications by Module v5, TSD P3 v3 appendix T-A.2 (API-P3-001 and API-P3-017); Functional Specifications by Module v6, FSD P3 v4 A2.19; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8 and 10
section: s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s14 Validation and messages
description: The legacy story names the case list with a team filter and an owner column, and the target keeps both, but four facts the story needs are not fixed by any source read for it. First, the team filter is a conflict: legacy section 12 says GET /cases takes the new query parameter team, the export operation API-P3-017 of the technical specification lists team, and the list operation API-P3-001 lists product, stage, status, owner, queue, deviation, ageFrom, ageTo, page, size and sort with no team at all, while the legacy flow and the FSD A2.19 both filter by queue, team and status. Second, the owner display name: legacy section 3 takes it from the ACE user directory in the common module, and no target source says which service resolves a staff display name, so the row can carry ownerUserId and nothing more. Third, the access-log write: the legacy story names the Java interface AccessEventPublisher with event code AC-EXPT and no operation, request body or status code, so the consumed row of section 12.2 and its fake cannot be fixed from the source. Fourth, the masking of the export columns: legacy BR4 applies the masking rules of RWB-E1-037 in the module, and in the target the masking policy belongs to rwb-access while no source says whether the policy is applied by rwb-case at workbook build or by a service of its own. The field identifiers of the parameter rows behind caselist.export.maxrows and of the LOV rows behind the filters are also absent from the legacy table and the FSD field catalog.
evidence: RWB-E1-031 section 12: request 'Query queue (uuid), status, owner, product, stage, page, size, sort; new query parameter team (see additions)' and interface AccessEventPublisher with eventCode AC-EXPT; TSD P3 v3 T-A.2 API-P3-001 request list has no team, API-P3-017 request list has team; FSD P3 v4 A2.19 step 1 filters and the three element steps of the flow; Architecture v5 slide 10 puts the merge of two answers in gateway-bff and keeps sign-in and the user directory in ACE Common; legacy sections 3 and 13 for the user directory and the masking by role; no source names the access-log operation path or its body.
legacy_ref: RWB-E1-031 (AC1, AC2, AC5, AC6, AC7, BR4)
proposed: Publish the team parameter as an additive optional filter on GET /cases, resolve the owner display name at the edge against the ACE Common user directory, name the rwb-access access-log operation in RWB-P4-E1039-CON with the AC-EXPT fields, and record that the masking rules travel in the authorise answer and are applied by rwb-case when it builds the workbook.

title: The row, envelope and page-token names of the case list and the 401 message text have no source
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-031 sections 7, 12 and 14; Technical Specifications by Module v5, TSD P3 v3 appendix T-A.2 (API-P3-001, API-P3-017); Functional Specifications by Module v6, FSD P3 v4 A2.19.3.2 field catalog
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s14 Validation and messages
description: The legacy story fixes the fields of one case row and the shape of the page (items, page, size, total) but not the schema names, the envelope name, the sort token or the page-token rule, and the technical specification gives only the response names CasePage and Case for the same operations, so the baseline document has to propose them. The 401 message identifier MSG-P4-001 appears in the legacy contract table without a text in section 14, and no source read here gives that text; the legacy story also fixes no maximum page size, which the queue-view story publishes as a parameter row. A consumer therefore needs one stated default for the names and one for the missing text before the document can be frozen.
evidence: RWB-E1-031 section 12: response 'CasePage: items (Case with caseNo, productGroup, status, stageCode, queueId, ownerUserId, teamCode, entryDate), page, size, total'; section 14 lists MSG-P3-020, MSG-P3-021, MSG-P7-003 and MSG-P4-002 with texts and names MSG-P4-001 in the error row of section 12 only; TSD P3 v3 T-A.2 gives the response names CasePage and Case and no schema or envelope detail; FSD P3 v4 A2.19.3.2 lists the case fields and no API shape.
proposed: Freeze the names in RWB-P3-E1031-CON as the legacy field names inside a CaseListRow and a CaseListPage of items, page, size and total, declare no cursor token, and take the 401 text from the rwb-access contract at the baseline review.
